topic: IOTA Simple Rules & Simple Rules Risk Model

benign_descriptors_rules.description: Single-cavity cyst with no septa and no solid tissue.
Solid component present with maximal diameter < 7 mm.
Acoustic shadowing present posterior to mass components.
Multilocular cyst with smooth inner walls and largest diameter < 100 mm.

malignant_descriptors_rules.description: Solid tumor with irregular, non-smooth external or internal contour.
Presence of peritoneal fluid outside the pelvis.
Presence of ≥ 4 distinct papillary projections (height ≥ 3 mm).
Multilocular-solid tumor with irregular walls and largest diameter ≥ 100 mm.

algorithmic_logic.step_1: If only B-rules apply (≥ 1 B-rule and 0 M-rules) -> Classify as BENIGN.
algorithmic_logic.step_2: If only M-rules apply (≥ 1 M-rule and 0 B-rules) -> Classify as MALIGNANT.
algorithmic_logic.step_3: If both B-rules and M-rules apply OR no rules apply -> INCONCLUSIVE (Apply IOTA ADNEX or refer to expert ultrasound).

applicability: Applicable to all non-physiological persistent adnexal masses in pre- and postmenopausal women.
